title: A 88-year-old Lagos landlord, Pa Adekunle Dare Aca, was murdered and his properties burned by his Hausa tenants. His daughter, Asa Kuburat, appealed to the Lagos military administrator, Col. Buba Marwa, for justice. The deceased was a native of Ikaramu Akoko, Ondo State, who resided in Lagos since 1935 and had Hausa tenants in his house. He was attacked and killed during a protest over the detention of Chief M.K.O. Abiola. The electrification of the Lekki Peninsula Scheme is expected to be completed soon.
